findings.highlight: are you going to ask someone to do something that you can’t do
findings.evidenceJa: 自分に出来ない事を人にやらせる気か
findings.governingReading: do you mean to make someone else do what you cannot do yourself
findings.explanation: The accusation of imposing an act on another person is softened into asking.

findings.evidenceJa: 貴方に強制するなんて
findings.explanation: Rin’s explicit admission that she tried to compel Shirou is softened to a request.

findings.evidenceJa: 触れれば一瞬にして肉塊にされる旋風
findings.governingReading: a whirlwind that would reduce anyone it touched to a lump of flesh in an instant
findings.explanation: The concrete bodily stakes of entering Berserker’s reach disappear into abstract “fatal destruction.”
Shirou’s body moving before conscious narration becomes a deliberate, generalized instant action.
